verdict.rationale: Mem0's self-hosted bundle documents per-user API keys and a request audit log, and entity-scoped memory (user/agent/app/session) provides some data separation, plus the MCP server enforces OAuth bearer auth. However there is no documented role-based access control, policy engine, or fine-grained ACLs governing who/what can read vs write specific memories, nor any audit query/reporting UI beyond 'a live audit log'. Missing for 10: RBAC/roles, configurable policies or ACLs, audit log query/export tooling, and platform (hosted) equivalent of the audit log (only mentioned for self-hosted).
